title: Record the milestones not stored today
goal: Record durable events, from now on and without backfill, for a base online for the first time, outages and recoveries, and pilot promotions, and show them in the chronicle.
acceptance: A base seen online for the first time, a base or model route going down and coming back, and a pilot promoted to a later stage each leave one durable, append-only record with its time, from the change onward (no backfill)
The Simple chronicle shows them with their sources; a promotion appears once a promote action exists (stage changes today are hand edits of config.json)
Owner decision 2026-11-12: recorded from now on; bugs closed stay out of the chronicle
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression for each new record and for no backfill; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Added 2026-11-12 on the owner's decision to record these facts from now on (F-054-T01 found they are not stored: only last_seen per base, route health in memory, pilot stages edited by hand). A judged 1.5 agent hours like the other F-054 steps; estimate, not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-12 (src/milestones.ts; hooks in Registry.seen, KajiLink.mark, Runtime.logRoutes and `pilots set`) in about 1 h agent (stated).
